markdown.markdown: ::: {.page-lede} Selected occasions where I have shared work on research funding, academic careers, quantitative methods, and education. ::: ::: {.talk-list} ::: {.talk-item .talk-featured} 13 August 2026Conference presentation **Gender Disparities and Institutional Prestige in Education Research Funding Networks** Presented at the 8th European Conference on Social Networks (EUSN 2026), Norrköping, Sweden. ::: ::: {.talk-item} June 2026Research seminar ## Who Gets Picked? **A Longitudinal Network Analysis of Gender and Institutional Prestige in Education Research Funding** Society and Health Research Centre Seminars, Universidad Mayor, Chile. ::: ::: {.talk-item} March 2026Guest lecture ## Independent research projects Guest lecture for the MA module *Independent Project (MCM999)*, School of Communication & Creativity, City St George's, University of London. ::: ::: {.talk-item} April 2019Academic poster ## Assessing the Student's t-test assumptions frequently noted in statistics textbooks Presented at the 1st National Research Techniques and Methods Meeting of the Chilean Association of Methodology, Measurement and Assessment (ACMME). Recipient of the William Gosset Award for best undergraduate academic poster. ::: ::: ::: {.cta-panel} ## Speaking interests I welcome opportunities to discuss social network analysis, gender inequalities in academic careers, educational transitions, and quantitative research design. [Get in touch](mailto:matias.montero@education.ox.ac.uk). :::
